summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EuroVault Investments new feature batch. Backend APIs 100% functional, frontend features working excellently with minor admin UI access issue.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin area URLs redirect to main page instead of showing admin login form. Admin functionality works perfectly via APIs.

passed_tests: ✅ Dashboard principal em /app/dashboard - saldo (€10,000 demo), ações rápidas, meta de investimento, programa de referidos all working
✅ Botão Conta Demo - successfully toggles balance to €10,000 and shows demo mode status
✅ Sino de notificações (data-testid=notification-bell) - found in topbar, opens dropdown, shows empty state correctly
✅ Admin Analytics API - /api/admin/analytics returns KPIs (total users: 6, deposited: 1, conversion rate, etc.)
✅ Admin Analytics CSV Export - /api/admin/export/leads downloads CSV file successfully
✅ Admin Leads API - /api/admin/users returns user list with checkboxes data, bulk action support
✅ Admin status changes - PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/status working for bulk status updates
✅ Admin Drawer APIs - 5 tabs all working: Financial (balance/profit), Notes, Deposits, Follow-up, Histórico/Audit
✅ Admin Chat APIs - templates list (/api/admin/chat/templates_list) returns 7 templates, conversations API working
✅ Trade Favorites - star icons visible and clickable, favorites API (/api/me/favorites) working
✅ Trade page - favorites appear at top of asset list, star icons turn yellow when clicked
✅ Admin authentication - brokereurope/Europeinvest working via API
✅ Demo mode toggle - /api/me/demo endpoint working perfectly
✅ Balance history - /api/me/balance-history returns 30 data points for dashboard chart
✅ Referral program - /api/me/referral returns code, count, bonus data
action_item_for_main_agent: Admin frontend routing needs adjustment - /admin and /adm/analytics URLs should show admin login instead of redirecting to main page. All admin functionality works via APIs.
